issues.issue: Whether the risk feared from La Familia Michoacan is linked to a Convention ground
issues.applicant_position: Extortion after brother's death; family threatened; organization could find them anywhere.
issues.result_text: Claimants credible, but the risk is not linked to a Convention ground; assessed under section 97.

issues.issue: Whether internal flight alternatives in Monterrey, Chihuahua or Guadalajara are reasonable
issues.applicant_position: Members everywhere and job or school registration leave a trail, so the cities are unsafe.
issues.result_text: No serious possibility of risk in the named cities; claimants are successful and can relocate.

issues.issue: Whether the claimants face risk to life, torture or cruel treatment in Mexico (section 97)
issues.applicant_position: Organization could find them anywhere in Mexico.
issues.result_text: No risk of torture, death or cruel treatment in Mexico; claims of husband and children rejected too.
